name: asmc-memory
description: Persistent semantic memory for Claude Code: involuntary recall injected into every prompt, every exchange remembered across sessions, plus recall / journal_write / set_mood tools. Local only, powered by ASMC.

storeDir.title: Memory store directory
storeDir.description: Where the memory lives (STM, LTM, mood, journal, the Python venv). Empty means ~/.claude/asmc-memory.

charBudget.title: Injected memory budget (characters) — no longer used
charBudget.description: Since 2026-11-14 nothing in the block is shortened or dropped: every entry is shown whole, and the sizes are the counts below. Kept so older configs still load.

recentCount.title: Recent exchanges to carry forward
recentCount.description: How many of the newest exchanges from earlier sessions are attached for continuity.

semanticCount.title: Semantic matches to attach
semanticCount.description: How many topically relevant past exchanges ASMC may attach per prompt.

autoStore.title: Remember every exchange
autoStore.description: Store each prompt and final answer automatically (the involuntary half). Off keeps only journal entries and moods.

injectMood.title: Carry mood forward
injectMood.description: Attach the last self-declared mood as a default, not a verdict.
